title: HHS/OCR RIN 0945-AA22 - HIPAA Security Rule to Strengthen the Cybersecurity of ePHI (latest agenda edition, labelled '2026')
claim: Latest Unified Agenda lists the Security Rule under 'Long-Term Actions' with Final Action 07/00/2027; the Spring 2025 agenda (pubId 202504) had it in 'Final Rule Stage' with Final Action 05/00/2026. The rule has been demoted and delayed.

title: HIPAA definitions: covered entity, health care, health care provider, individual
claim: Covered entity = health plan, clearinghouse, or health care provider transmitting standard electronic transactions; 'health care' relates to the health of an 'individual' (the person who is subject of PHI). Veterinary care of animals is therefore outside HIPAA; veterinary practices are generally not covered entities. Dental practices that bill electronically are.
excerpt: Health care means care, services, or supplies related to the health of an individual.
limitations: Application to vets is our reading of the definitions (consistent with secondary sources); vets remain subject to state record-confidentiality and data-breach laws (not verified here).

Onboarding free; remediation scoped separately; 12-month term then month-to-month; hardware/M365/cabling billed separately.
excerpt: Available add-ons ... Huntress EDR/SIEM, Proofpoint advanced email security

title: Chicago FY26 budget bill increases various taxes, creates new social media amusement tax
claim: Effective 2026-01-01 Chicago's personal property lease transaction tax (which reaches nonpossessory computer leases, i.e., cloud software) rose from 11% to 15%, with no further increases before 2028-01-01.

organization: City of Chicago Department of Buildings
title: Electrical Contractor License
claim: Chicago electrical contractor licences are 'general' or 'low voltage'; low voltage covers Class 1-3 remote-control, signaling, power-limited and communications circuits; requires employing a licensed supervising electrician; 2026 fee $150 initial/renewal, valid one year. Structured data cabling in Chicago must be done by a licensed contractor - subcontract it.
excerpt: A "low voltage" license only allows ... electrical work involving Class 1, 2 and 3 remote-control, signaling and power-limited circuits and communications circuits.
limitations: Whether patch-cord/device swaps without new wiring need a permit not stated; suburban rules differ.

claim: Proposed: effective 60 days after a final rule, standard 180-day compliance period; written procedures to restore critical systems within 72 hours; backup controls tested at least every 6 months; vulnerability scans at least every 6 months; penetration testing; MFA; annual compliance audit; HHS estimated ~$9B first-year and ~$6B/yr years 2-5 industry cost.

title: HIPAA Security Rule administrative safeguards
claim: Existing (in-force) Security Rule requires covered entities AND business associates to conduct an accurate and thorough risk analysis, implement risk management, security awareness training, and a data backup plan, disaster recovery plan and emergency-mode operation plan.
excerpt: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information
limitations: Federal text; applies to the MSP itself as a business associate.
